post.description: Retrieve tasks with optional filters
Delete one or more scheduled or failed tasks

Requires content:render for scoped keys. Submission queues work and does not wait for completion. Reuse the same body and idempotencyKey to recover a job.

parameters.name: orgId
parameters.description: Optional organization selection for a key authorized for that organization. Usually derived from the bearer key; never grants access to another organization.

200.description: Job accepted or current job state. A completed, failed or cancelled render is also an HTTP 200 job-state response.

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired API key.

409.description: Idempotency key already used with different request content.

charactersPerSecond.description: Complete visible grapheme clusters per second.

pauseBeforeMs.description: Pause before typing or the local reply gesture; follows reserved native transition completion.

pauseBeforeSendMs.description: Pause between the completed local composition and sending.

variation.description: Seeded proportional variation in character delay.

incomingTypingDurationMs.description: Explicit remote response duration; overrides calculated incoming typing duration. May be global or on incoming messages only.

IMessageTiming.description: Every field is optional. Per-message timing takes precedence over global timing. Defaults shown apply after both levels are checked.

emoji.description: Exactly one complete emoji grapheme. Available for remote participants only.

delayMs.description: From target message arrival, or video start for initial history. Earliest picker-open time for local actions; exact arrival time for remote actions.

menuDurationMs.description: Local picker hold before selection. Remote reactions do not open a local picker.

IMessageReaction.description: Setting again replaces that actor’s prior reaction. Remove requires an existing reaction from the same actor. Local actions accept only the six classic reactions and use the visible native menu.

sender.description: user or recipient for direct chats; a participant ID for groups.

text.description: Nonempty printable Unicode, at most2,000 UTF-16 code units. Supply exactly one text, imagePngBase64 or imageUrl body.

imagePngBase64.description: Base64 single-frame PNG without data URL prefix; decoded size at most 2048×2048. Mixed image/text captions are unsupported.

initial.description: Preexisting history; initial messages must be a prefix.

showTyping.description: Incoming indicator override. Not accepted on outgoing messages.

receipt.description: Outgoing messages only; read requires readAt.

readAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with an explicit timezone.

replyTo.description: An earlier message ID; never a forward reference.

sentAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with an explicit timezone.

imageUrl.description: Public HTTPS PNG/JPEG/WebP URL without credentials, explicit ports or fragments; application rejects private destinations, unsafe redirects, invalid images and downloads above12MiB. Converted to bounded PNG before native validation. Message images fit2048px; supply exactly one text, imagePngBase64 or imageUrl body.

IMessageMessage.description: IDs must be unique; omitted IDs become message-1, message-2, etc. If any message sets sentAt, all must set it in chronological order. timestampText forces a separator before this message.

batteryPercent.description: Native battery fill, not a numerical percentage label.

avatarPngBase64.description: Base64 PNG bytes, without a data URL prefix. Decoded image must be a single-frame PNG, at most 512×512 pixels. Native ContactsUI crops the avatar.

avatarUrl.description: Public HTTPS PNG/JPEG/WebP URL without credentials, explicit ports or fragments; application rejects private destinations, unsafe redirects, invalid images and downloads above12MiB. Converted to bounded PNG before native validation. Avatars fit96px; cannot be combined with avatarPngBase64.

avatarPngBase64.description: Base64 PNG bytes, without a data URL prefix. Decoded image must be a single-frame PNG, at most 512×512 pixels. Native ContactsUI crops the avatar.

avatarUrl.description: Public HTTPS PNG/JPEG/WebP URL without credentials, explicit ports or fragments; application rejects private destinations, unsafe redirects, invalid images and downloads above12MiB. Converted to bounded PNG before native validation. Avatars fit96px; cannot be combined with avatarPngBase64.

avatarPngBase64.description: Base64 PNG bytes, without a data URL prefix. Decoded image must be a single-frame PNG, at most 512×512 pixels. Native ContactsUI crops the avatar.

avatarUrl.description: Public HTTPS PNG/JPEG/WebP URL without credentials, explicit ports or fragments; application rejects private destinations, unsafe redirects, invalid images and downloads above12MiB. Converted to bounded PNG before native validation. Avatars fit96px; cannot be combined with avatarPngBase64.

atMs.description: Exact requested millisecond timestamp; omission chooses the final authored frame. Must not exceed compiled duration.

IMessageConversationOutput.description: Video is 60 fps H264 at 1126×2436. PNG is 1125×2436; no crop, resolution or codec control.

idempotencyKey.description: Organization-scoped retry key. Reusing it with changed input returns 409.

unreadCount.description: Back-button badge; message count is messages.length.

keyboard.description: Hide/show keyboard; outgoing emoji selection and local replies require true.

threads.description: Explicit read-only expanded reply views. Open after conversation/native transitions settle; views cannot overlap.

IMessageConversationInput.description: Synthetic conversation authoring only; no real message delivery. Total request limit 16 MiB, 6,000 animated graphemes,120-second compiled duration, and 16,777,216 aggregate message-image pixels. Unknown fields reject. Cross-field/native availability constraints are also validated; see full contract.

cancelRequested.description: Cancellation requested; not proof cleanup has finished. Poll to terminal status.

durationInFrames.description: Output frame count; PNG output is 1.

durationMs.description: Compiled conversation duration, even forPNG jobs.

url.description: Present on completion: publicly downloadable owned HTTPS media URL.

estimatedCaptureRemainingMs.description: Observed-rate estimate for capture only. Null before sufficient samples, outside capture, or when stale; excludes queue, encoding, and upload.

IMessageConversationResponse.description: Raw HTTP response. SDK normalizes this to ApiResponse with ok:true and a message.

IMessageRequestError.description: Error shape varies between authentication middleware and renderer. errorCode/retryable are provided for native conversation request failures.
